title: ehos.bundle/v1
description: bundle.json, the index of a bundle: the files a deployment of one image takes, written together by one command beside that image (D-146). A released version is frozen: this file is never edited, and any change is a new version. Beside this schema, EHOS refuses a bundle whose graph documents hold more than 33554432 bytes in all, or that names a path twice.

schema.description: The version of this format the index is written in. An index without it is refused, never guessed at.

graph.description: Each graph document of the application, at most 512; empty for an application with no contracts.

manifest.description: The application's manifest, as `mix eh_os_contract.manifest` writes it, at the bundle's root.

graph_document.description: A graph document of the application (D-123), as `mix eh_os_contract.graph --output-dir` writes it, in the bundle's `graph/` directory.

path.description: Where it is, relative to `bundle.json`: in `graph/`, named as the command names it.

bytes.description: Its size in bytes, at most 1 MiB, as EHOS reads a manifest and a graph document.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, in lowercase hexadecimal.
